method: base x 0..75, y 5..40, z 0..2.5 (trimmed 5 by each flange's setback); bend 1 (R 2.5..5 about y 5, z 5) x 0..75 and bend 2 (R 2.5..5 about x 75, z 5) y 5..40, both ending at the trimmed base corner (75, 5); the panels mitred by the rule's gap: each runs on past its bend by ext = (R+t) - (t + gap/sqrt2) = 0.732233047, so flange 1 y 0..2.5, z 5..30, x 0..75.732233047 and flange 2 x 77.5..80, z 5..15, y 4.267766953..40 (each t + gap/sqrt2 short of the other's outer face); minus two d6 through holes at (25,20), (55,20) in the base. A = sum of prism areas - 2 x 4 joint areas (75t, 75t, 35t, 35t) + hole walls - hole discs
note: the corner belongs to the two bends that meet there, whichever flange was made first: the panels are mitred by the rule's gap as in one command (69). The open corner the flat model left, where the earlier flange's panel ran on to x 80 alone, depended on the order the flanges were made.
